mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, coupon_name, category, money, total_stock, remain_stock, per_limit, start_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM coupon WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted = 0 AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY category ASC, money DESC

SELECT id, shop_id, coupon_name, category, money, total_stock, remain_stock, per_limit, start_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM coupon WHERE deleted = 0 AND category = 1 AND expire_time > NOW()
SELECT id, shop_id, coupon_name, category, money, total_stock, remain_stock, per_limit, start_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM coupon WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET remain_stock = remain_stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remain_stock > 0
UPDATE coupon SET remain_stock = remain_stock + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (shop_id, coupon_name, category, money, total_stock, remain_stock, per_limit, start_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{couponName}, #{category}, #{money}, #{totalStock}, #{totalStock}, #{perLimit}, #{startTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
